import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxN = 70;
    static final int maxn = 50;
    static final int lim = 22;
    
    static long[][] C = new long[maxN + 5][maxN + 5];
    
    static void prepare() {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxN; ++i) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }
    
    static int n, m, N;
    static int mid;
    static int[] g = new int[maxN + 5];
    
    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long sum;
        int cnt;
        Pair(long s, int c) { sum = s; cnt = c; }
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            return Long.compare(this.sum, o.sum);
        }
    }
    
    static ArrayList<Pair>[][] partb = new ArrayList[maxn + 5][maxn + 5];
    static Map<Long, Long>[][] parta = new HashMap[maxn + 5][maxn + 5];
    
    static long ans = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static long ans_cnt = 0;
    
    static boolean chkmin(long[] a, long b) { // not used, we use direct
        if (a[0] > b) { a[0] = b; return true; }
        return false;
    }
    
    static void update(long val, long cnt) {
        if (val < ans) {
            ans = val;
            ans_cnt = cnt;
        } else if (val == ans) {
            ans_cnt += cnt;
        }
    }
    
    static void dfs_partb(int x, int cnta, int cntb, long sum) {
        if (x == mid) {
            partb[cnta][cntb].add(new Pair(sum, 1));
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
            if (g[x - 1] != -1 && i != g[x - 1]) continue;
            long tmp = 0;
            if (i == 0) {
                if (cnta > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) 
                        tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
                    dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta - 1, cntb, sum + tmp);
                }
            } else {
                if (cntb > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                        tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
                    dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta, cntb - 1, sum + tmp);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // lower bound in sorted list of Pair by sum
    static int lowerBound(ArrayList<Pair> list, long key) {
        int lo = 0, hi = list.size();
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid).sum < key) lo = mid + 1;
            else hi = mid;
        }
        return lo;
    }
    
    static void bfs_parta() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; ++i) 
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; ++j) 
                parta[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
        parta[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; ++i) 
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; ++j) 
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> u : parta[i][j].entrySet()) {
                    long sum = u.getKey();
                    long cnt = u.getValue();
                    if (i + j == mid) {
                        int p = lowerBound(partb[i][j], -sum);
                        if (p < partb[i][j].size()) 
                            update(Math.abs(sum + partb[i][j].get(p).sum), cnt * partb[i][j].get(p).cnt);
                        if (p > 0) 
                            update(Math.abs(sum + partb[i][j].get(p - 1).sum), cnt * partb[i][j].get(p - 1).cnt);
                    } else {
                        int p = i + j;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {
                            if (g[p] != -1 && k != g[p]) continue;
                            int cnta = i, cntb = j;
                            if (k == 0) ++cnta;
                            else ++cntb;
                            if (cnta <= n + m && cntb <= n + m) {
                                long tmp = 0;
                                if (k == 0) {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l) 
                                        tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                } else {
                                    for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l)
                                        tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                }
                                long newSum = sum + tmp;
                                parta[cnta][cntb].put(newSum, parta[cnta][cntb].getOrDefault(newSum, 0L) + cnt);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
    }
    
    static void work() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; ++i) 
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; ++j) 
                partb[i][j].clear();
        dfs_partb(N, n + m, n + m, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; ++i) 
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; ++j) {
                ArrayList<Pair> list = partb[i][j];
                Collections.sort(list);
                ArrayList<Pair> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
                int sz = list.size();
                for (int k = 0; k < sz; ) {
                    long cur = list.get(k).sum;
                    int cnt = 0;
                    while (k < sz && list.get(k).sum == cur) {
                        cnt += list.get(k).cnt;
                        ++k;
                    }
                    tmp.add(new Pair(cur, cnt));
                }
                partb[i][j] = tmp;
            }
        bfs_parta();
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        prepare();
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        String s = sc.next();
        N = (n + m) << 1;
        mid = Math.max(0, N - lim);
        Arrays.fill(g, -1);
        work();
        ans_cnt = 0;
        // Now set g according to s
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == 'A') g[i] = 0;
            else if (c == 'B') g[i] = 1;
        }
        work();
        System.out.println(ans_cnt);
        sc.close();
    }
}
